privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.body:
Litopys stores the goals, notes and productivity scores you enter so it can show them back to you and generate periodic reports.

What we store: your email (for sign-in), your profile (name, language, gender), and your journal data (goals, notes, reports).

AI processing: to generate reports, the text of your notes is sent to OpenAI for summarisation. Do not write anything you would not want processed by a third-party AI provider.

Your rights: you can export all of your data as JSON, and you can delete your account and all associated data at any time from the Profile screen.

This is a student project; this text is a plain-language summary and not formal legal advice.
